facts.statement: The Snowy Days seasonal event returned to Snowhill, a time when decorations and gifts can be found under the Gifting Tree in the Snowhill town center.
facts.quote: Les Jours Enneigés sont de retour!

article_summaries.title: Le Retour des Jours Enneigés! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing the return of the Snowy Days (Jours Enneigés) seasonal event in Snowhill. It describes the Abominable Snowman and his snowmen stealing gifts from the Gifting Tree, the snowball-based defense, the daily gift quest from an NPC, and holiday outfits. The article gives no numbers, dates or reward amounts.
